title: Local weight of a nonfalsified literal
statement: Let $\ell$ be a literal on $n$ coordinates. Assign weight $1/2$ to the free restriction and weight $1/4$ to each of the two restrictions fixing the coordinate to $1$ or $-1$. The total weight of restrictions under which $\ell$ is not falsified is $3/4$.
